resources.string: Come back after a door call
When the intercom takes the screen, come back here 4 minutes later. The wait is deliberate: this panel cannot tell when a call ends, so returning sooner risks covering one.
Starts hidden. Tap the small line in the bottom-right corner to raise it; it hides again after 8 seconds.
A dim clock covers the page. A touch brings the panel straight back, and it comes back by itself when the hours below end.
Rest the page under the clock

Stops drawing the dashboard while the clock covers it, to use less memory overnight. The page keeps running, so Home Assistant can still open a camera on this panel and the clock still steps aside for it.
How loud a camera plays when Home Assistant opens one on this panel. Leave keeps whatever the panel is already set to.
Lets the panel turn its own screen off at the time you chose. Nothing else.

Type the outdoor station’s address and password, then tap Save and test. The panel then asks the outdoor station whether the call has ended, so it comes back within seconds instead of waiting 4 minutes.
Opens Android\'s own list of home apps. Use this to go back to the vendor launcher, or to make this panel the home app.
This Android has no home-app screen. Use the device\'s own Settings › Apps.
